definitions.Gamma: The second ascending branch of S reaches a local maximum X with 0 < f(X)-f(S) < ell.
definitions.count: N_max(W_r;D) is the number of local maxima x in D with f(x) in W_r.

proof: On Gamma_r there exists a local maximum X reached by the second branch.
Since f(S)=b-ell and 0<f(X)-f(S)<ell, one has b-ell<f(X)<b.
Thus X is counted by N_max(W_r;T_L^2).

exact_integrand.base_law: gamma_{r,b}: exact periodized BF Gaussian law conditioned on the six value/gradient pins at M and S
exact_integrand.pair_weight: W_MS=|det H_M det H_S| 1_{H_M negative definite} 1_{H_S saddle}
exact_integrand.count_expectation: E_Palm N_max(W_r;D)=integral_D integral_{b-ell}^b lambda_max^Palm(x,u;r) du dx
marks_retained: third-point height in the exact gain window

collars.target: The local maximum-window count is at most the all-critical collar count and has an explicit C_col^max r^3 ceiling.
collars.available_input: COL supplies the O(r^3) shape; its explicit coefficient remains unresolved.

near.target: The exact determinant-weighted maximum-window Kac--Rice integral is <=C_near^max r^3 uniformly.

exterior.target: The exact typed pair-Palm maximum-window intensity has a uniform finite transfer factor relative to the stationary maximum-height density.

C097_supersession_map.principle: The C097 selected-critical-value density theorem remains a valid standalone route. It is no longer the weakest-link route for the Gamma upper bound because a first-moment count avoids selecting and differentiating the branch terminal.

obligations.GAIN_RESIDUAL_VARIANCE_FLOOR: NON-LOAD-BEARING-FOR-GAMMA-UPPER; retained for selected-value density and other anti-concentration applications
obligations.GAIN_PALM_FIBER_WEIGHT: SUPERSEDED-AS-A-SELECTED-DENSITY-OBLIGATION; the exact Palm numerator/denominator remains inside Kac--Rice

findings: The typed pair-Palm denominator reproduces the archived r=0.05 and r=0.025 determinant-weight anchors within the frozen Monte Carlo uncertainty.
Across three rungs and four exterior stations per rung, the maximum-window intensity ratio lies between approximately 0.9847 and 1.0103 of the stationary benchmark.
Pair-scaled and fixed-near stations are highly anisotropic and mostly suppressed; no sampled outside-collar station exceeded the stationary benchmark by more than about 1.1%.

coefficient_consequence.interpretation: The count route is designed to prove a finite cubic rate and q0, not to preserve the inherited 4.35 total coefficient. Its natural Gamma coefficient is order one.

terminal_status.q0_effect: If the three count obligations and the existing interceptor/collar conditions are discharged with finite constants, q(r,6/5)->1.
